rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by an OBN approver or the Board, accredited providers (e.g. ANCC, ACCME, ACPE), activities approved by other states' nursing boards or Ohio health-profession boards, academic credit (converted to contact hours), BLS/PALS/ACLS with a compliant certificate
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal after licensure by NCLEX. Licensed by endorsement 1 year or less before first renewal: 12 contact hours incl. 1 Category A.
rules.audit_note: Nurses attest on the renewal application; the Board may ask for proof of completion. Keep CE records 6 years.

topics.who: Category A: Ohio nursing law and Board rules

rules.notes: Reporting period runs July 1 to June 30 ending in the odd renewal year. Renewal window July 1 to Oct 31 of odd years. A one-time CE waiver can be used for one renewal period on written request.
rules.rule_quote: (A) A nurse applying to renew an active license to practice nursing as a licensed practical nurse or registered nurse in Ohio must complete twenty-four contact hours of continuing education during the reporting period, unless an exception applies,…
rules.carryover: Not allowed: extra hours cannot be applied to a later renewal period (OAC 4723-14-03).
rules.legal_basis: Section 4723.24, Ohio Revised Code; Chapter 4723-14, Ohio Administrative Code (rule 4723-14-03)

rules.notes: Renewal July 1 to Sept 15 of even years; late renewal (extra $50) Sept 16 to Oct 31. Fee shown is single-state ($75 multistate). An LPN who also holds an active Ohio RN license need not meet the LPN CE separately. One-time CE waiver available.
